stopConditions: Required source files are missing or materially contradictory.
The implementation would exceed named scope — in particular any pull toward auto-merging research PRs, writing to explorations/INBOX.md, or feeding raw scraped bytes to the PR-writer stage.
A hard rule (sanitize-at-write, blinding, single-writer ledger, PR-only) cannot be satisfied mechanically. Report rather than weaken.
Verification requires unnamed credentials, cost, destructive side effects, or policy approval.
The same blocker repeats after reasonable investigation.
